title: Airbnb checkout message and instructions: templates, timing and a checklist
summary: Airbnb checkout message templates, a three-task checkout checklist, when to send it, and how to offer late checkout without risking same-day turnovers.
body_markdown:
**Checkout is the tightest hour of a short-term rental. One guest is packing, a cleaner is waiting, and on nearly half of all checkouts on ProhostAI another guest arrives the same day. The checkout message decides how that hour goes. It tells the guest when to leave, the few things to do before they go, and whether they can stay a little longer. Below are five checkout message templates you can copy, a checkout instructions checklist, and the timing that works, based on what hosts on ProhostAI actually send.**


*How we measured: checkout times from about 404,000 confirmed stays that checked out in the last 12 months, in each listing's local time; message timing from 13,076 checkout messages sent by 50 workspaces in the 7 days before checkout; cleaning times from 30,985 completed turnovers with a timed start and finish between 10 minutes and 12 hours; same-day turnovers from 398,510 checkouts in the last 12 months. Internal workspaces excluded (read-only aggregate of ProhostAI data, November 2026).*
